title: BSIM4 A2 clamp state of the NIST decks, audit and fix; selected g v2 recipe on both NIST DEV datasets
status: in force from the commit that adds this file (committed alone, before any I20-1 RRMS value, rerun, training or S3_D value)

states.L: stored deck: all sweeps in one process, b4check.c clamp in the first analysis only
states.C: clamp written into the card: A2_eff > 1 -> a2 = 1, la2 = wa2 = pa2 = 0, a1 = la1 = wa1 = pa1 = 0 if A1_eff != 0; A2_eff < 0.01 -> a2 = 0.01, la2 = wa2 = pa2 = 0; unclamped card unchanged
states.U: one op before the curves (audit only)

effective_a2.nist_4K: bin a2 (77 K bins: no l/w/p A1/A2 terms, asserted)
effective_a2.nist_rt_card_4K: a2 + la2 Inv_L + wa2 Inv_W + pa2 Inv_LW, Leff = L + xl - 2 dl, Weff = W/nf + xw - 2 dw, binunit 2

reported: A2_eff and clamp class per card
GMR M_bias v1 vs C0_refit, B3_d3 vs C0_refit, M_bias v1 vs B3_d3 per state
other size-dependent b4check.c clamps per stored card
part_A_audit.other_clamp_rule: if a stored card triggers another b4check.c clamp, the fix is extended by an amendment before the reruns

validity.V1: state L reproduces start, C0_refit, M_bias v1 rows (|diff| <= 1e-12, NaN = NaN); other arms per arm, 'not reproduced' arms not reported as audit values
validity.V2: C = L = U (difference 0) for every card with 0.01 <= A2_eff <= 1
validity.V3: clamped cards: A2_eff = b4check.c printed value (rel 1e-5); no A2 message on other cards; state-C curve 1 = state-L curve 1 where finite

part_C_reruns.start_records: state C from the stored starting cards, no refit; unclamped start cards identical to stored records
part_C_reruns.lodo: C0_refit and M_bias v1, I8-1 / I9-1 recipe (5 seeds, 2000 steps; refit max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01), amendment A1 exclusion; T1_inloop and baselines not rerun
part_C_reruns.s3_v1: I19-1 v1 definition (seed 0, 500 steps, leave-one-device-out over finite DEV records, no refit), state-C records

part_D_g_v2.penalty_grid: 73 x 73, 0 .. 1.8 V, 25 mV, forward quadrant of the state-C starting card, u_d > 0, I > 1e-9 A

selection.deviation: 6 selection blocks instead of per-outer-fold selection (compute)
selection.blocks: finite DEV devices sorted by (polarity nMOS first, tag); device i -> block i mod 6
selection.per_block: training = finite DEV devices outside the block; 3 inner folds (I15-2 rule); per inner fold and lambda one member (seed 0) on the other inner folds (load order); inner held-out refits (state C); score mean ln RRMS (non-finite = 0); argmin, ties within 1e-12 to the larger lambda
selection.lambda_h: lambda* of the block holding h
selection.full_data: same selection over all finite DEV devices; 5-seed full-data model at lambda*_full stored (TEST), not scored

part_D_g_v2.lodo: per finite DEV device h: 5-seed model at lambda*_h on all other finite DEV records (load order); held-out refit with g frozen; strict paper RRMS
part_D_g_v2.s3_g_v2: I19-1 definition: per device k one member (seed 0, 500 steps, lambda*_k) on all other finite DEV records, applied without refit; S3_D = mean ln ratio

part_E.primary: GMR(selected g v2, C0_refit), state C, device bootstrap 10000 seed 0, per NIST dataset; label I17-2 primary_label (gain over C0_refit replicated: CI upper < 1 and 0 failed rows among finite-start devices; worse: CI lower > 1; else inconclusive)
part_E.secondary: GMR(selected g v2, M_bias v1), state C, margin 1.05 (I17-2 secondary_label)
reported: GMR(M_bias v1, C0_refit) state C vs stored

part_F_gate.amendment_rule: decisions recomputed from S3_D v1 state C and S3_D g v2 for both NIST datasets; if any of the 4 decisions differs from the committed (a755e18: apply, apply), a dated amendment out/research/explore/I19_1/test_gate_amendment_<date>.{json,md} is committed before any TEST run, listing the changed decisions, S3_D values and the frozen-rule decision; a755e18 files not edited; otherwise no amendment
part_F_gate.frozen_s3_recipe: v1 recipe (I19-1 v1 definition, state-C starting records) for every dataset; the gate applies the selected g v2 correction iff this S3_D < 0
frozen_s3_reasons: threshold 0 and S3 calibration (I7-1 OLS, I19-1 Part C 19/20) exist for the v1 recipe only
part_F_gate.nist_check: k/2 per statistic: sign(S3_D) vs realised sign of ln GMR(selected g v2, C0_refit), no threshold

validity_reruns.V5: rows complete (C0_refit, M_bias v1, selected g v2 for every finite-start device; 6 x 15 + 15 selection trainings per dataset; S3_D for every finite record)
validity_reruns.V6: TEST closed (loaded tags in DEV list, not in TEST list)
validity_reruns.V7: penalty grids 73 x 73 finite, forward corner current > 0
validity_reruns.V8: state-C starting records of unclamped starting cards identical to stored records

known_before_registration: mechanism check: A2_eff > 1 on 16/57 (I8-1) and 35/87 (I9-1) starting cards, 0 stock cards, 0 low clamps; b4check.c value = computed A2_eff on 51/51 clamped cards; other lines are warnings without a clamp and the I8-1 A1 Pclm fatal
g v2 training timing on I9-1 records (synthetic grid): 0.038 s/step lambda 0, 0.24 s/step lambda > 0, 86 devices
I8-1, I9-1, I9-2, I18-1, I19-1 DEV outcomes; I19-1 TEST gate decisions a755e18
order: queue: audit, start C, S3_D v1 C, LODO C0_refit/M_bias v1 C, pens, block selection, full selection, S3_D g v2, g v2 LODO nist_4K, g v2 LODO nist_rt_card_4K, decide, figures
report batch, site, RESEARCH_LOOP, freeze draft
compute_estimate: 8 workers, one job at a time: about 13-14 h wall (g v2 LODO about 10 h)
